methodology.clock: parent monotonic wall time immediately before child-process launch through receipt of every byte of the first fixed UTF-8 transcript over a dedicated pipe after backend synchronization
methodology.clock_excludes: child WER post-processing, JSON writing, and process teardown
methodology.clock_includes: Python/runtime imports, manifest parsing, fixed-audio verification, local model resolution, model loading, and first inference
methodology.compiler_cache_detail: one benchmark-scoped TorchInductor, Triton, and CUDA JIT cache seeded before measured fresh-process launches
methodology.process_isolation: every seed and scored sample uses a new child process
methodology.warning: This measures repeat activation from locally cached artifacts. It is not first installation, machine reboot, or resident-request latency.
methodology.weights: already downloaded; Hugging Face and Transformers offline modes enabled

offering.attention: sdpa for Qwen3-ASR and Whisper; native default for Parakeet TDT
